images.title: A 2 by 2 by 2 cube on the grid
images.purpose: Shows a 2 by 2 by 2 cube drawn on an isometric grid, its 9 visible edges coloured by direction, each 2 units.
images.composition: Plain white background with generous empty margins; the main object is large and centred and fills about 60 percent of the frame; nothing else is drawn. One cube centred on a faint isometric grid that fills the frame.
images.exact_structure: Background: a faint light grey isometric grid of vertical lines and two families of lines slanting at 30° above horizontal, left and right, making equal triangles. On it, centred, a cube with every edge 2 grid units long, outline a regular hexagon, with 9 visible edges drawn thick: 3 vertical edges in teal #0072B2 (left side, front corner, right side), 3 edges slanting up to the right in amber #E69F00, 3 edges slanting up to the left in green #009E73. Each thick edge has a small tick at its midpoint marking the 2 units. The 3 faces are white. Labels: '2' beside one teal edge, '2' beside one amber edge, '2' beside one green edge; 'height' next to the front teal edge, 'length' next to the lower amber edge, 'depth' next to the lower green edge; '18 units' under the cube. So '2' appears 3 times. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Count units along each direction: 9 visible edges of 2 units each make 18 units.

image_decisions.why: Drawing on the grid is counting units along three directions; one cube coloured by direction shows how.
